block.description: A provider for advanced time manipulation functions including RFC3339 parsing and strftime formatting.

days_difference.description: Returns the number of complete days between two RFC3339 timestamps as an integer string. Positive if end is after start.

parse_rfc3339.description: Parses an RFC3339 timestamp and returns a JSON string with year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and unix timestamp

strftime.description: Takes an RFC3339 timestamp and formats it using strftime format specifiers (e.g., '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

unix_timestamp.description: Takes an RFC3339 formatted timestamp string and returns the Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) as a string.
unix_timestamp.summary: Convert RFC3339 timestamp to Unix timestamp
